name: ONS-LTIM-Passenger-Survey-4.01
what_it_holds: ONS Long-Term International Migration (LTIM) estimates derived from the International Passenger Survey: table 4.01, citizenship group by sex by age by country of last/next residence. Part of the GSS (Government Statistical Service) Cogs data-pipeline conversion of ONS reference tables to tidy CSV/CSVW.
why_useful: Same underlying IPS instrument as the trip-purpose tables, but this specific table is migration-flow demographics, not tourism trip-purpose/length-of-stay -- limited direct use, mainly confirms IPS-derived data is published in machine-readable form by GSS-Cogs (worth checking sibling repos for a trip-purpose/duration table).
size_hint: single reference table, historical ONS release
themes: Length-of-stay, party-size and trip-purpose survey microdata (NTTO SIAT, UK IPS, Eurostat tour_dem, Japan travel survey, national travel surveys)
why_all: Same underlying IPS instrument as the trip-purpose tables, but this specific table is migration-flow demographics, not tourism trip-purpose/length-of-stay -- limited direct use, mainly confirms IPS-derived data is published in machine-readable form by GSS-Cogs (worth checking sibling repos for a trip-purpose/duration table).

name: ONS-LTIM-Passenger-Survey-4.02
what_it_holds: Official UK Government Statistical Service (GSS-Cogs) ETL pipeline (main.py, Jenkinsfile) that reformats/publishes ONS's 'International Passenger Survey Migration to and from United Kingdom by main reason for migration by citizenship groups' (table 4.02 of the Long-Term International Migration series) as linked/tidy data. No large committed raw CSV visible at top level -- it is a transform pipeline pointing at the ONS source, not a data mirror. Very old (2019), 0 stars.
why_useful: Same caveat as 4.01 -- IPS-sourced but migration-reason, not trip-purpose/party-size/length-of-stay for tourism. Low direct relevance; flags that the GSS-Cogs org (github.com/GSS-Cogs) is a broader source of ONS/IPS-derived tidy-data repos worth a follow-up scout with topic search.
themes: Length-of-stay, party-size and trip-purpose survey microdata (NTTO SIAT, UK IPS, Eurostat tour_dem, Japan travel survey, national travel surveys)
why_all: Same caveat as 4.01 -- IPS-sourced but migration-reason, not trip-purpose/party-size/length-of-stay for tourism. Low direct relevance; flags that the GSS-Cogs org (github.com/GSS-Cogs) is a broader source of ONS/IPS-derived tidy-data repos worth a follow-up scout with topic search.

Confirms the IPS/LTIM tables exist as a maintained ONS statistical series with a citizenship x migration-reason breakdown; the pipeline code shows exactly which ONS bulk-data endpoint to hit for a one-command pull. Marginal on its own for trip-purpose/length-of-stay (this table is about migration reason, not leisure/business visit duration) but documents the acquisition method for the wider IPS family.
